name: Force Sunder
body:
School evocation [force]; Level magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target one object
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes (object)

You use arcane force to crush or shatter an object. The object takes 2d6 force damage per caster level, maximum 20d6. If the object is not destroyed by the damage, you may make a caster level check against the object’s break DC. The object may make a Fortitude save to halve the damage, or if held by a creature, the holder can make a Reflex save to halve the damage instead.
